{{Top|leg}}
'''Trogliths''' were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] creatures that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]]. Early colonists from [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] fought with trogliths for living space, and [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]] of Yelsain's early skirmishes were popular across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Along with the [[Garath|garaths]] they're considered the most dangerous predators on Yelsain.<ref name="GG6-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
